why: The Aytürk Technique is a source-specific lesson design combining several existing activities around a distinctive rhythmic-table product, rather than a sufficiently general instructional element or established adoptable programme.
This is a setting-specific application of creative activities to develop learners' creativity, so its evidence belongs on Fostering Creative Thinking rather than creating a new principle.
